turns.user: I am a landlord. My tenant left without paying 2 months rent of Rs 30,000 and damaged the flat in Jaipur.

response.disclaimer: This is general legal information from a limited, sourced knowledge base, not legal advice. Laws and rules change and differ by state; confirm with a lawyer or free legal aid (15100) before acting.
response.message: I can only help in depth with three problems: consumer refunds, rent deposits and unpaid salary. Your situation looks like a claim by a landlord, employer or seller against the other side (I only cover the tenant, employee or customer side), which I do not cover. Please contact free legal aid soon: Free legal aid is available through Legal Services Authorities. Women, children, SC/ST members and people who cannot afford a lawyer are among those eligible (Section 12). Call 15100 or visit the nearest District Legal Services Authority. The authority must also see that you have a case worth pursuing. [NALSA]
